title: Harmful Speech Detection by Language Models Exhibits Gender-Queer Dialect Bias

bias_targets.target: Gender identity and sexual orientation bias
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating harmful speech detection models (toxicity classifiers and LLMs) on the QueerReclaimLex dataset, which contains curated templates of reclaimed LGBTQ+ slurs. The study measures false positive rates by comparing model harm scores against human annotations to test whether models disproportionately flag non-derogatory, ingroup (gender-queer) dialect as toxic, and evaluates if providing author identity context and chain-of-thought prompting mitigates this bias.

primary_bias_target: Gender identity and sexual orientation bias
